svg.title: Property Repair and Service BPMN Flow
svg.desc: BPMN diagram showing the full lifecycle of a property repair request across tenant, property manager, and technician swim lanes

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What details should be in a repair request?')
sendPrompt('When and how does a tenant provide property access?')
sendPrompt('How does a tenant evaluate completed repair work?')
sendPrompt('How should a property manager log and categorize repair requests?')
sendPrompt('What is the escalation process for urgent property repairs?')
sendPrompt('How do property managers select and assign contractors?')
sendPrompt('What does the invoice approval process look like?')
sendPrompt('What steps close a repair request in the system?')
sendPrompt('How does a technician receive a repair job notification?')
sendPrompt('How should repair visits be scheduled with tenants?')
sendPrompt('What does the on-site repair process involve?')
sendPrompt('What happens when a repair is incomplete or unsatisfactory?')
sendPrompt('What should a completion report include?')
